points.description: States that homogeneous coordinates allow rotation, translation and scaling to be represented in a uniform way, e.g. all as matrix multiplication / a single 3x3 matrix form (translation can then be expressed as a matrix like the others).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it helps represent transformations as matrices without the uniform/translation idea.

points.description: States a benefit: easier/more efficient computation or optimization, e.g. transformations can be combined (concatenated) into one matrix and computed faster by the computer.
points.partial_credit: Half if benefit is vaguely stated.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying homogeneous coordinates give one uniform matrix form for translation, rotation and scaling, plus a simple benefit like easier or faster calculation. Give 1 mark if only one of these ideas is present, in any wording. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers.
